citations.claim: light body pressed against wall face just before tunneling
same body centre is past the wall (10 to 10.1) at first violating step, proving crossing

explanation: A heavy fast body (m=20, vx=60) strikes a light body (m=0.2) parked 0.1 from a thin 0.1-wide wall. The two-body collision impulses accelerate the light body to ~60 m/s in one step; the wall collision substepping/impulse then fails to stop it and its centre jumps from x=9.7 to x=10.82 across the [10,10.1] wall between steps 2 and 3, i.e. secondary impact velocity after a mass-ratio-100 crush exceeds the wall CCD handling.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 2 and 3

vision_note: The large blue body moves right across steps 0-2 toward the thin vertical wall where the tiny red body is parked just left of it. In step 3 the red body appears on the right side of the wall while the blue body remains left, showing it tunneled through the wall.
